limitations: Only owned anonymous HTTP/1 loopback control and injected native/API transport are executed; no native HTTP/2, external authentication, media, HEAD, upload, browser, account or host trust work
Internal SolverHTTPClient remains solely the existing Go test seam; no public control transport or private Session/Solver test API is introduced
Loopback validates ordinary direct control and independence from native proxy; environment proxy bypass remains source-guarded because Go also exempts loopback hosts from environment proxy
